notes.title: Team Ninja says 'we sincerely apologize' for Rise of the Ronin's PC version being a mess, promises imminent fixes
notes.notes:
The ambitious ARPG Rise of the Ronin released on Steam a few weeks ago and, from the get-go, proved to be yet another terrible PC port from Team Ninja. The game has undeniable qualities but they're buried beneath a myriad of performance issues, and user reviews are "Mixed" with every negative relating in some way to how it's running...
                Read more.

notes.title: Rise of the Ronin Steam® version Update Ver. 1.09.0.1 (03/14/2025)
notes.notes:
■ System Updates and Adjustments
・Adjusted the settings of presets.
Settings that heavily effect performance have been adjusted within the preset.
You can manually increase individual settings.
・Added ”Recommended” preset 
The recommended preset is the most suitable based on the specifications of your PC.
・Adjusted name of setting "FPS Limit" to "FPS"
This option will lock the FPS to the set number. We have adjusted the wording of the setting for better accuracy.
We have also added supplementary explanations to highlight its impact to performance.

■ Bug fixes
・Fixed an issue where the game would crash on launch, for CPUs with 33 threads and above
・Fixed an issue where the game would get stuck loading in specific situations
・Fixed stuttering issues in specific stages and circumstances
・Fixed an issue where interacting with the Veiled Edge Banner under specific circumstances would lead to crashes
・Fixed an issue where inputting directional keys when receiving "Midnight" rewards in the Testament of the Soul would lead to getting trapped in the menu
・Fixed an issue where selecting OPTIONS rapidly at the title screen would disable further input

notes.title: Rise of the Ronin is another crappy PC port, performance patch coming 'soon'
notes.notes:
Rise of the Ronin arrived on Steam this week, a year after its debut on PlayStation 5, and I'm sorry to say it's not going well, as players are reporting serious performance problems with the game. Koei Tecmo says it's now "investigating" the reports and working on a patch that will hopefully "fix or improve some of these issues."..
                Read more.
